name: CompSniper
description: CompSniper helps people make faster, better resale and sourcing decisions with real completed eBay marketplace data. Search completed sales for a product, receive compact listing rows with title, sold price, shipping, condition, sold date, seller, and URL, and get cleaned price intelligence including median, p25, p75, realistic ranges, sample size, currency, and raw-versus-cleaned evidence. Compare multiple products or the same product across eBay marketplaces. For deeper research, Max Mode runs an asynchronous sold-comps sweep and provides a signed CSV export when complete. The connector uses OAuth 2.0 so each user authorizes their own CompSniper account and quota. It reads public marketplace sold data through CompSniper's first-party API and is not affiliated with eBay. It does not access a user's unrelated files, full conversation, Claude credentials, or OpenAI credentials.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CompSniper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CompSniper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.compsniper.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CompSniper MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CompSniper provides these MCP tools: cancel_max_search, compare_marketplaces, compare_products, export_sold_comps, get_account_usage, get_api_status, get_max_search_results, get_price_summary, get_remaining_quota, search_multiple_products, search_sold_comps, and start_max_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CompSniper?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CompSniper in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
CompSniper requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CompSniper is developed by CompSniper. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
